items.rationale: Manually compared the 0.0.2 successor's current blocks and fourteen real anchors with initialization, controller and route source plus the governed setup and exact-plan observation contracts. The guide now distinguishes unscoped global publication admission from an explicitly selected signed operator's own CURRENT publications, preserving incomplete aggregate readiness and foreign AUTHORITY_PENDING. It explains false/empty versus true/bounded selection metadata, normal BEFORE/CMS recovery, narrow-group restrictions, singleton mutation and fresh original-receipt recovery. BEFORE Media SOURCE_READY is correctly metadata admission with separate exact CMS mediaDependencies.qualified=true; AFTER SOURCE_READY is never installed CURRENT. Read-only exact-plan observations, safe messages and business/provider limits are explicit. This satisfies the requested explanation without treating hashes, Online delivery or an installed release as financial/browser acceptance.
sourceFindings: normalizePreparationStep/afterPublicationSelection/isPreparationOperator and controller/route schema confine one exact required AFTER stage to the original human access token, signed tenant/enterprise aliases and bounded Bearer. Narrow Commerce groups retain independent action permission and cannot omit selection to bootstrap CMS.

scopedAfterPublicationPreparation gates singleton DATA_RELEASE validation/install on every same-operator publication CURRENT, not foreign CURRENT. The selected publication alone submits; other own publications are status-only. Foreign required stages remain AUTHORITY_PENDING or separately observed, visible and non-optional; local success does not close the aggregate.

invoke preserves false/empty selection metadata before BEFORE/CMS/Media admission and true/bounded metadata afterward, including honest empty selectable lists. Selected AFTER ignores CMS forceRefresh, never writes BEFORE/Media/CMS approvals and retains receipts through a fresh full status invocation without automatic write retry.

mediaPreparationStatus returns SOURCE_READY for fresh persisted CURRENT metadata with storedBytesVerified:false; preparationStatus/sharedPreparationObservation admit that BEFORE Media state into preparation.status CURRENT. CMS READY/ONLINE and exact Media qualified=true remain a separate gate. Required AFTER steps must be CURRENT, never merely SOURCE_READY.

setupObservation validates complete effective profile before/after fixed exact-plan service reads; observeForeignPreparation compares SOURCE/TARGET/SOURCE publication operation/digests and exact installation/source bytes. Disabled-by-default adoption, minimal bounded evidence, no cached foreign proof and no local/financial mutation authority are correctly explained.

Existing capabilityBusinessStatus and user-safe message/diagnostic distinctions remain intact. New diagrams, worked request shape, rejection cases and fresh recovery instructions do not assert browser execution or provider acceptance.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: Backend projection accuracy does not prove a deployed Axis screen renders or enforces the contract; browser and permission acceptance remain separate.

These explanations satisfy the backlog request without asserting the walkthrough was executed in a browser.
